kjv: which always causeth us to triumph in Christ
mine: who in Christ always leads us in triumphal procession
note: thriambeuo is to lead in a Roman triumph, where captives were paraded; Paul pictures himself as Christ's captive (cf. Col 2:15), not as a victor.

kjv: which corrupt the word of God
note: kapeleuo is to hawk goods for profit (a retail huckster); "corrupt" catches the dishonesty but not the money.
